title: Normality, regularity and dimension under an etale stalk map
statement:
Let $e:U\to X$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], let $u\in U$, and put $x=e(u)$, $A=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and $B=\mathcal O_{U,u}$. Then the local homomorphism $A\to B$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map],
$$\dim A=\dim B,$$
with Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and
$$A\text{ is a regular local ring}\ \Longleftrightarrow\ B\text{ is a regular local ring},$$
$$A\text{ is an integrally closed domain}\ \Longleftrightarrow\ B\text{ is an integrally closed domain}$$
[def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Here neither scheme is assumed globally Noetherian. The normality comparison concerns the indicated local rings, and does not assert that their fraction fields or residue fields are isomorphic.

Agent scheme-stalk assembly of these ring results, extracted from inherited step 14.

proof.text: The stalk map of the etale morphism is flat and local. Give the target stalk the algebra structure induced by this map and apply faithful flatness of flat local homomorphisms. This is the first conjunct.

For an etale ring map f:R→S and a prime q of S put A=R_(f⁻¹q) and B=S_q. Apply RingHom.Etale.ringKrullDim_localization_eq for dimension equality, including infinite dimension. Regularity ascends directly by the already proved upstream localized etale ascent theorem. For descent A→B is flat local, hence faithfully flat. A regular local B is regular by regular-local localization; faithful flat descent makes A regular, hence regular local since it is local.

For the same localizations normal-domain ascent is precisely the already proved upstream localized etale normal-domain ascent theorem. For descent, B a normal domain implies every prime localization is a normal domain. Apply faithfully flat normal-ring descent to A→B. The localization of the local ring A at its maximal ideal is isomorphic to A, because all elements inverted are units. Transport its domain and integral-closedness predicates back along that isomorphism.

The conjunction of dimension equality, equivalence of regular localness and equivalence of being an integrally closed domain respects ring isomorphisms at either end: transport dimension with ringKrullDim, regularity with IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv, domainhood with MulEquiv.isDomain and integral closedness with IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv. Apply Mathlib HasRingHomProperty.stalkMap_of_respectsIso to the etale morphism and the localized ring result. This theorem chooses affine neighborhoods, identifies the stalk map with the map on prime localizations, and transports along the resulting ring isomorphisms. Combine with the faithful flatness from the first step.
